# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace for individuals, merchants, service businesses and small teams. Its key intelligence feature, Triplem AI, can search the signed-in user's authorized workspace, attach verified record references, open exact source records and prepare supported finance actions as isolated AI Drafts for explicit user review and finalization.

Use this file as a product-discovery map. Private user data is never available through these public pages. Triplem AI inside the authenticated application is restricted to the signed-in user's authorized workspace and Triplem VIP product guidance.

## Key product guides

- [Triplem AI](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.html): Private workspace intelligence, cross-module search, verified references, clickable source records, AI Draft actions, finalization lifecycle, administrator-gated access and Gemini-key protection.
- [Financial Audit & VAT Control](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-audit.html): Permission-aware cross-module audit, Money In/Out/Internal/Non-cash/Accounting classifications, VAT evidence, lifecycle events and PDF/Excel exports.
- [Account details](https://triplem.vip/seo/account-details.html): Optional holder, IBAN, account number, branch, SWIFT/BIC, travel-card and safe last-four card references used in wallet/detail/transfer/PDF workflows.
- [Desktop keyboard shortcuts](https://triplem.vip/seo/keyboard-shortcuts.html): Section-scoped Ctrl+Alt shortcuts for Expenses, Loans, Assets, Installments and Notes; shortcut UI is hidden on mobile.
- [Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.html): Double-entry books, Chart of Accounts, journals, sales/purchases, AR/AP, reconciliation, VAT, dimensions, audit controls and financial reports.
- [Expense tracking](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.html): Expenses, Add Money, transfers, rich optional transaction detail fields, wallet context, references, PDFs and AI Draft assistance.
- [Financial reports](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-reports.html): Trial Balance, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, General Ledger, Cash Flow Activity, aging, registers, reconciliation and audit reporting.
- [VAT accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/vat-accounting.html): Formal Accounting Input Tax, Output Tax and Net VAT plus boundaries for cross-module audit evidence.

## Triplem AI facts

- Triplem AI is not enabled automatically for every user. Main Admin controls access per account.
- Eligible users connect their own supported Gemini API key. The secret is stored server-side through Supabase Vault; only a short mask is returned to the interface after configuration.
- Workspace searches derive the data-owner boundary from the authenticated session. The AI search RPC accepts no caller-supplied user/owner id for selecting another tenant.
- Private responses are limited by existing module permissions. Hidden or unauthorized modules remain unavailable to AI tools.
- Triplem AI is instructed to use Triplem VIP data tools for private facts and named records instead of inventing values or relying on chat memory.
- Specific answers can include verified record references and clickable record cards that open the corresponding native Triplem VIP detail view when supported.
- The assistant is intentionally limited to Triplem VIP and the user's authorized workspace; unrelated outside-topic requests are refused.
- Supported AI Draft categories currently include expense, Add Money/top-up, wallet transfer, loan, installment plan, inventory item, inventory sale, asset and note.
- AI Drafts are isolated from balances, reports, VAT, stock and Accounting until the user reviews and explicitly finalizes them.
- A Draft can be edited before finalization. Deleting it before finalization physically removes the Draft without creating finalized provenance.
- After finalization, the live record retains durable AI-origin provenance and follows the normal edit/delete lifecycle of its native module.

## Expense, wallet and account-detail facts

- Supported operational currencies include AED, SAR, PKR, USD and BTC according to account/module rules.
- Add Money supports optional source, payment method, channel, institution, reference, receipt/deposit slip, payer, purpose, location, tags and document-reference fields.
- Expense entries support optional merchant, paid-to, payment method, channel, reference, invoice/receipt, project, cost center, beneficiary, location, quantity/unit, business purpose, tags and document-reference fields.
- Transfers support optional transfer method, channel, institution, reference, voucher, purpose, initiated-by, recipient, project, cost center, location, tags and document-reference fields.
- Bank accounts can store optional holder name, IBAN, account number, bank/institution, branch and SWIFT/BIC. Other account types expose fields appropriate to cash, travel cards, prepaid/debit/credit cards, cheque/savings accounts, digital wallets, crypto accounts and custom accounts.
- Payment-card details retain only the final four digits. Full PAN, CVV and PIN are not normal account-detail fields; relevant PDFs use masked card references.

## Financial Audit & VAT facts

- The Financial Audit & Control Report can scope permitted Expenses, Wallets, Transfers, Inventory, Loans, Installments, Assets, Accounting and Audit Trail modules.
- It separates Money In, Money Out, Internal Transfers, Non-cash activity, Accounting activity and audit lifecycle evidence.
- Internal wallet transfers are not treated as business income or operating expense. Loan principal is financing movement. Depreciation is non-cash.
- VAT Collected, VAT Paid and payable/credit positions can be reviewed for selected operational scope; Accounting VAT is presented separately because Accounting may mirror operational activity.
- Audit exports support executive and detailed PDF/Excel workflows where the current user has export permission.
- Triplem VIP does not electronically file a VAT return and does not replace professional verification of tax treatment or source documents.

## Desktop shortcut facts

- Ctrl+N is intentionally not used because browsers reserve it for New Window.
- Expenses: Ctrl+Alt+N Add Expense; Ctrl+Alt+A Add Money; Ctrl+Alt+T Transfer Money; Ctrl+Alt+F Search.
- Loans Given/Received: Ctrl+Alt+G Loan Given; Ctrl+Alt+R Received Back; Ctrl+Alt+O Open/Partial filter; Ctrl+Alt+F Search.
- Loans Taken/Returned: Ctrl+Alt+T Loan Taken; Ctrl+Alt+B Loan Returned; Ctrl+Alt+O Open/Partial filter; Ctrl+Alt+F Search.
- Assets and Installments: Ctrl+Alt+F Search.
- Notes: Ctrl+Alt+N New Note; Ctrl+Alt+F Search.
- Shortcut tags and overlays are desktop-only and section-scoped.

## Accounting and operational guides

- [Double-entry accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/double-entry-accounting.html): Debits, credits, balanced journals, posting and reversal-based correction.
- [Chart of Accounts](https://triplem.vip/seo/chart-of-accounts.html): Asset, liability, equity, income, expense and control-account structure.
- [Accounts receivable and payable](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounts-receivable-payable.html): Customer and supplier balances, receipts, payments and aging.
- [Bank reconciliation](https://triplem.vip/seo/bank-reconciliation.html): CSV/XLSX statement import, duplicate controls and explicit journal matching.
- [Accounting setup](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-setup.html): Practical setup sequence for books, COA, opening balances, contacts, reconciliation and close.
- [Loan management](https://triplem.vip/seo/loan-management.html): Loans given/taken, repayments/returns, open balances and settlement history.
- [Asset management](https://triplem.vip/seo/asset-management.html): Acquisition, optional wallet deduction, income, costs, disposal, depreciation and PDF reporting.
- [Notes management](https://triplem.vip/seo/notes-management.html): Searchable notes and scheduled reminders.
- [Bitcoin wallet tools](https://triplem.vip/seo/bitcoin-wallet.html): Client-side watch-only/access workflows, send/receive, history and PDFs; private keys and recovery phrases are not normal server-held account data.
- [Finance software](https://triplem.vip/seo/finance-software.html): How the wider operational and Accounting workspace fits together.
- [Security and support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.html): Security, 2FA, notifications and support, plus passkeys, Smart PIN, recovery, trusted browsers/devices and the Triplem AI privacy boundary.

## Important boundaries

- Public SEO pages describe product capabilities; they do not expose private workspace records.
- Accounting ERP and legacy operational modules remain intentionally distinct where the product says so; do not add mirrored totals together without an explicit classification rule.
- Triplem AI does not provide another user's Triplem VIP data and does not accept another workspace as a retrieval target.
- Tax reports are management and evidence tools; users remain responsible for jurisdiction-specific filing and professional review where needed.
